body.zh: 通过task-init/register创建每任务inputs、outputs、tmp目录；标题或负责人变化不改变任务编号。
body.en: task-init/register creates inputs, outputs and tmp for each stable task ID. Renaming or reassignment does not change that ID.

body.zh: artifact-add复制正式成果到outputs，使用UTC时间、简短名称及唯一后缀；保留旧版，记录大小与内容校验值。不会扫描或自动归档所有文件。
body.en: artifact-add copies verified outputs with a UTC timestamp, short slug and unique suffix, retaining prior files and recording size/hash. It does not scan or archive all files automatically.

body.zh: 参考图片、文档放所属任务inputs；草稿和中间渲染放tmp。工具写到其他位置的成果，交付前主动归档；保留Library文件身份。
body.en: Place reference images/documents in task inputs and drafts/renders in tmp. Explicitly archive outputs produced elsewhere before delivery; preserve Library identity.

body.zh: 规划统一收件箱接收尚无归属的资料；明确用途后再归档，不强行创建任务。尚未创建全机收件箱或迁移旧文件。
body.en: Plan one inbox for material without a task, then classify it when its purpose is known. No global inbox or historical migration is implemented yet.

body.zh: 长期复用素材进入统一共享资料区；优先引用，需要锁定版本时才复制快照。共享区尚未落地，不自动整理旧文件。
body.en: Use a shared reference area for reusable material. Prefer references and copy a snapshot only when a fixed version is needed. The shared area is not implemented; old files are not automatically reorganized.

title.zh: 代码项目与一次性交付

body.zh: 长期维护的网页和程序放独立项目源码目录，任务保存资料、检查记录和交付快照；一次性单文件作品可从tmp制作并归档到outputs，不能把唯一成果只留在缓存。
body.en: Keep maintained websites and programs in a dedicated source project; task folders retain references, checks and delivery snapshots. One-off single-file works may be drafted in tmp and archived to outputs; never leave the sole deliverable only in cache.

body.zh: 面板运行数据保存在独立DATA中；任务目录和数据库不放进开源源码。公开发布前仍须人工核查文件清单。
body.en: Panel runtime records live in private DATA separately from source. Keep task folders and databases out of public source; manually review publication contents.

body.zh: 系统软件交给对应安装方式管理，不为统一目录搬动系统文件；配置、用户数据与缓存分开，核实实际桌面用户后再选择路径。
body.en: Let the relevant installer manage system software. Do not relocate system files for tidiness; separate configuration, data and cache after verifying the actual desktop user.

title.zh: 手工软件独立版本目录

body.zh: 规划apps/<app-id>/<version>，用户数据不放程序版本目录。此安装规则尚未实施，项目代码继续留在现有仓库。
body.en: Plan apps/<app-id>/<version> with user data outside application versions. This installation layout is not implemented; source projects remain in their existing repositories.

body.zh: 软件发现计划读取明确来源，候选项确认后再纳管；检测到不等于运行中。当前仅白名单检测，无通用安装、卸载和进程控制。
body.en: Planned discovery reads explicit sources and requires review before management. Detection does not imply running. Current support is allowlisted detection, not general installation, removal or process control.

body.zh: 仅为已确认的软件实例提供其支持的操作；不按模糊名称结束进程。平台、桌面连接和系统组件保持只读。移除登记、卸载程序、删除数据分别处理。
body.en: Expose operations only for verified instances with supported capabilities. Never stop processes by fuzzy names. Keep platform, desktop connection and system components read-only. Treat deregistration, uninstalling and data deletion separately.

title.en: Reuse an activity for one goal

body.zh: 同一目标的实现、测试、修复和交付记录在同一活动；复用经验证的执行身份，不能把面板登记冒充独立平台会话。
body.en: Record implementation, testing, fixes and delivery for one goal in one activity. Reuse a verified executor identity; a panel record is not an independent platform conversation.

body.zh: Agent状态与任务生命周期分开；职责表示当前工作类型，随任务变化。标明最近观察时间，未核实时显示未知，不伪造实时连接或完成。
body.en: Separate agent state from task lifecycle. Work type follows the current assignment. Show observation time and unknown values where unverified; do not invent live connections or completion.

body.zh: 报告和图片按相应验证流程检查后登记；面板文件记录不等于已向用户提供下载。需要聊天附件时使用经验证的文件交付方式。
body.en: Validate reports and images before registration. A panel record does not prove the user can download it; use a verified attachment workflow for chat delivery.

body.zh: 这些是项目工作规范，不改变账户权限或平台安全要求。旧文件迁移、软件安装卸载、数据删除和公开发布按用户授权处理，不因显示规则而自动执行。
body.en: These are project workflow guidelines, not account permissions or overrides of platform safeguards. Handle migration, installation, removal, deletion and public sharing under user authorization, never merely because a rule is displayed.

body.zh: receive在既有活动下原子写入waiting_external运行与接收事件；相同request-id与内容重试复用运行，不重开终结记录。它不派发平台执行者。
body.en: receive atomically records a waiting_external run and receipt on an existing activity. Identical request-ID retries reuse the run without reopening terminal work. It never dispatches a platform executor.

body.zh: 协调者唯一接收，把run与request-id交给执行者；执行者只核验续写。成功派发立即关联真实友好档案并读回，失败记录阻塞。Skill不能保证自动触发，CLI无平台锁。
body.en: The coordinator owns receipt and passes run/request IDs to the worker, which verifies and continues them. Immediately link verified executor profiles after dispatch and read back; record failures. Skill invocation is not guaranteed; the CLI has no platform lock.

body.zh: 不可把无关任务转入忙碌执行会话；同目标复用活动，原执行者忙别的主题时另派或明确排队。阶段保存目标、约束、成果、验证与下一步；长期上下文无固定保证，独立审核者不参与制作。
body.en: Never steer unrelated work into a busy executor. Reuse the goal activity; use another executor or record waiting when the former one is busy elsewhere. Save sanitized goal, constraints, outcomes, checks and next step. Context retention is not guaranteed; independent reviewers do not produce the work.
